source_basis.note: Source-published defaults. DELTA uses Dukascopy tick count as bar-volume proxy because centralized exchange volume is unavailable.

causal_grammar.fast_anchor: A strict new 30-bar low starts/refreshes a bullish leg; a strict new 30-bar high starts/refreshes a bearish leg. If both occur on one bar, candle direction resolves: bullish candle -> bullish leg from the low, bearish candle -> bearish leg from the high.
causal_grammar.same_type_extreme: A more extreme same-direction anchor refreshes that leg from the new extreme.
causal_grammar.opposite_extreme: Flips leg direction and reanchors immediately on the completed bar.
causal_grammar.vwap: Cumulative sum(hl2 * capped tick-count weight) / sum(capped tick-count weight), reset on anchor.
causal_grammar.sigma: Volume-weighted standard deviation from same anchor.
causal_grammar.retest: touch low<=VWAP+tol and high>=VWAP-tol after committed away counter >=5; away bullish if low>VWAP+tol, bearish if high<VWAP-tol.
causal_grammar.entry: Retest bar itself is the signal; execute first P75 tick at/after completed bar end.

gates.advance_rule: Advance unchanged lane only if supply and nonnegative direct net pass.
